messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — GPU sizing window for DEAL-4832

Samuel / Stratus team,

Quick context: Nebula (DEAL-4832) is asking to lock a dedicated pool sized for their 6k concurrent tokens workload. We need a short lead-time plan that makes the customer commit visible to OEM and cloud backstops.

Ask: please confirm the following by EOD tomorrow (Thu):
- OEM quote for 8x A100-style cards (per-tranche / per-shipment pricing) and lead time (min, typical, max).
- Whether Nebula can move to a staggered delivery (2 + 3 + 3) and what impact to price/ETA that has.
- Stratus: can you provide a soft reservation for 8 GPUs in us-west-2 for the Oct–Nov window as a cloud backstop? If so, provide the booking reference or confirmation email.

Attachments: I will upload the draft SOW and sizing assumptions separately — for now please attach any quote stubs.

Next steps: after we have OEM lead times and Stratus confirmation, Karthik will run the risk matrix and I’ll propose the gating milestones (commit windows / escrow / credit).

Thanks — short and direct.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415-555-0107

Tessa, Karthik — thanks for the heads up.

Summary of current OEM position (preliminary):
- SKU: Nebula P4-80 (comparable to A100 40GB)
- Price (baseline): $32,800 / unit. Tranche discounts apply at 4+ and 8+ units (we can push to $30,900/unit at 8+ depending on shipping window).
- Lead times: typical 12–14 weeks from PO confirmation; expedited lanes (~8–9 weeks) available at 7% premium and subject to factory slot availability.
- Staggered shipments: acceptable. Best practice is 2 / 3 / remaining to smooth logistics; shipping documentation and customs can add 3–7 business days per tranche.

I attached a quote stub (nebulacorp_quote_v2.pdf) and a simple table of lead-time ranges.

Constraints: our factory slots tighten in mid-Oct due to other enterprise bookings — if you need an Oct onramp, PO needs to clear by Aug 20.

Let me know if you want me to hold tentative slots for Nebula while you finalize the SOW.

Cheers,
Sam
Samuel Greene
Head of Sales, OEM Partnerships — Nebula Corp

Short internal note plus asks to vendors.

Karthik here — quick risk/readout: if OEM lead time is 12–14 wks, worst-case delivery slips into late Oct/Nov which is outside Nebula's preferred Oct onramp. Options:
1) Push Nebula to accept staged pool and degrade to smaller initial tranche (4 cards) with cloud-bursting to Stratus for first 6–8 weeks.
2) Pay expedited premium to push to ~8–9 wks (accepting 7% cost uplift), but we need PO by Aug 20.
3) Hybrid: reserve cloud capacity for Oct as a paid backstop and stagger OEM shipments.

Asks to vendors (Sam / Stratus):
- Sam: can you provisional-hold the factory slots for Nebula and issue a tentative PO cut-off date confirmation? We need explicit cutover dates for our commit milestones.
- Stratus: can you provide two items: (a) a one-page booking confirmation showing 8 GPU soft-reservation in us-west-2 for Oct 1–31; (b) a short note on burst pricing if Nebula exceeds reserved capacity for short windows?

I’ll prepare the gating matrix (commit dates, refund/credit terms, fallback ops) once we have those two items.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference

Subject: Action: gating milestones & what we need from Nebula to proceed

Thanks Sam — and thanks Karthik for the clear options. To keep this lean I put together the gating milestones below. Please confirm or flag edits.

Proposed gating (DEAL-4832):
- Milestone 1 (Commit intent): Aug 15 — Nebula signs a non-binding intent letter (shows runway to PO). No funds yet.
- Milestone 2 (PO window): Aug 20 — PO submission to Nebula (OEM) to secure Oct slots. If PO submitted by Aug 20, OEM confirms Oct tranche.
- Milestone 3 (Cloud backstop): Sep 01 — Stratus to provide booking confirmation for 8 GPUs in us-west-2 (soft reservation) covering Oct 1–31; if not available, Stratus should confirm best-effort replacement region/zone and burst pricing.
- Milestone 4 (Staging): Oct 01 — first tranche delivery / cloud-burst begins.

Vendor asks (summary):
- Sam: please escalate a tentative slot hold and give us a PO cut-off confirmation. Also confirm price hold if PO hits by Aug 20 (we need the 8+ threshold price).
- Stratus: please send the one-page booking confirmation (a stub is fine for now) and the burst-overage pricing table.

I’ll put these milestones in the SOW and share a one-page gating matrix with legal/finance for the refund/credit language.

Thanks — please reply inline.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
